pdf.roundingNote: Amounts are rounded once, on each total, so the rows can differ from the total by a cent.
pdf.noTeamHours: No hours were booked on the team's projects in this period.
pdf.teamNote: The report has only the hours booked on the team's projects, as totals. Single entries are visible only to the person who booked them.
pdf.ownInTeamNote: The report has only your own hours on the team's projects.

setup.subject: Welcome to HexTime
setup.body:
An account has been created for you in HexTime, for tracking working time.

Set your password here:
{link}

The link works once and for {days} days.

signup.subject: HexTime: finish signing up
signup.body:
Someone, hopefully you, asked for a HexTime account for this address.

Choose your password here to finish:
{link}

The link works once and for {days} days. If you did not ask for this, ignore this message: no account can be used without it.

reset.subject: HexTime: new password
reset.body:
Someone, hopefully you, asked for a new HexTime password.

Choose a new password here:
{link}

The link works for {hours} hours. If you did not ask for this, ignore this message: your password stays as it is.

verify.subject: HexTime: confirm your email address

teamInvitation.subject: HexTime: an invitation to the team {team}

desktop.tooNewBody: Your data was saved by a newer version of HexTime than this one. Install the newest version to carry on. Your data has not been touched.
desktop.startFailedBody: Your data could not be opened: {error}. If it was being updated, a backup was taken first, in the same folder: {folder}
